rv.q: It might just turn out to be the year's best new play.
Sometimes a play's writing and staging align perfectly, allowing a compelling story to soar into space.
Nevertheless, the overall narrative of the play is highly engaging – even powerful – as it follows Tito's journey to self-discovery.

cn.t: Critics largely embrace *Radio Galaxy*, praising its emotional depth and sharp humor. Rishi Golani's performance anchors this moving world premiere about a teen science prodigy navigating identity and belonging.
